name: recoil_state_save_load_transition_on_try_become_current
description: RecoilStateSaveLoadTransition::OnTryBecomeCurrent optionally captures and pauses presentation/audio state, loads dialog sounds, creates the selected save or load dialog, stores it, activates it, and returns success.
known_limits: The native smoke covers the transition-owned no-capture save/load dialog selection and activation path. The capture branch is accepted compositionally from Binary Ninja evidence plus accepted helper targets for video half-res mode, HUD invalidation mode, zSnd mute application, active-play-handle snapshots, snapshot stop, zFMV_ActionBlur construction/update, and zSndSampleSet::InitByName.
tier S verification is deferred to a coherent RecoilApp state-transition pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x435d20 validates the optional capture branch, saved half-res mode write, paused-audio snapshot storage, blocking blur loop, DIALOG sound-set initialization, save/load dialog allocation by m_dialogKind, m_dialog storage, SetEnabled(1), and return value 1.

The native smoke patches HudUiBackground::LoadFromZrd and verifies both save and load no-capture paths allocate the correct dialog specialization, request the expected ZRD section, store the dialog pointer, activate the dialog, preserve the expected selected-entry index, and return 1.
